description.value: Queen Elizabeth Meadows is a 2.9-hectare (7.1-acre) public park in Surrey featuring rolling meadow grassland and open green space. The QE Meadows Community Garden was initiated by students from Queen Elizabeth Secondary School and built with community help in 2017. A diagonal walking path through the park connects 134 Street directly to Queen Elizabeth Secondary School, offering cyclists a quiet green corridor through the neighbourhood.
